differential: Aufhebung: simultaneously negate, preserve, and elevate; no single English word captures the triadic movement
Geist: not ghost or soul but the self-developing rational totality; 'mind' loses the collective-historical dimension
das absolute Wissen: not omniscience but the point where subject-object opposition is overcome; 'knowledge' risks empiricist reading
Selbstbewußtsein: consciousness that takes itself as object; structurally requires recognition by another self-consciousness
Negation der Negation: not simple return to origin but determinate negation yielding concrete universal; double negative is not positive
Wirklichkeit: not mere existence but the unity of essence and existence; 'reality' conflates with Realität which Hegel distinguishes
Idee: not Platonic form but the adequate concept that has realized itself; unity of concept and objectivity
Begriff: not abstract general notion but self-differentiating concrete universal; the living movement of thought
Vermittlung: not external linkage but internal self-movement through negation; opposed to immediacy (Unmittelbarkeit)
Wesen: not hidden substrate but being-that-has-been (gewesen); the reflective dimension of being
Sein: the most abstract and empty category; identical with nothing precisely because it lacks all determination
Nichts: not nihil absolutum but pure indeterminacy identical with pure being; their truth is becoming
Werden: the first concrete category; unity of being and nothing as ceaseless passing-over
Dasein: being with a determinateness (quality); not Heidegger's Dasein but simply there-being with specific character
Widerspruch: not formal logical error but constitutive motor of development; things perish through their own contradiction
Reflexion: not psychological introspection but logical self-relation of essence; positing, external, and determining reflection
Verstand: fixes categories as separate and opposed; necessary but insufficient moment that reason (Vernunft) sublates
Vernunft: grasps the unity of opposites that understanding separates; not Kant's regulatory faculty but constitutive self-movement
Vorstellung: picture-thinking that religion uses; midway between sensory intuition and conceptual thought (Begriff)
Gegenstand: that which stands over against consciousness; distinguished from Objekt which is more logically constituted
Ware: not merely a product but an object produced for exchange; bears the dual character of use-value and exchange-value
Gebrauchswert: qualitative utility of an object; the material bearer of exchange-value but irreducible to it
Tauschwert: the quantitative proportion in which use-values exchange; phenomenal form of value (Wert), not value itself
Mehrwert: value produced by labour beyond the value of labour-power; the specific form of exploitation under capitalism
Entfremdung: worker's estrangement from product, process, species-being, and others; not psychological malaise but structural relation
Verdinglichung: social relations appearing as relations between things; Lukács extended Marx's commodity fetishism into this concept
source: Marx, Das Kapital I; Lukács, Geschichte und Klassenbewußtsein

differential: Arbeitskraft: capacity to labour sold as commodity; distinguished from labour (Arbeit) which is the actual expenditure of that capacity
Ideologie: not false belief but the inverted consciousness produced by material conditions; camera obscura metaphor
Dialektik: Marx inverts Hegel's idealist dialectic; retains contradiction as motor but grounds it in material production relations
Überbau: legal, political, ideological forms arising from economic base; not mechanically determined but relatively autonomous
source: Marx, Zur Kritik der politischen Ökonomie, Vorwort

differential: Basis: totality of relations of production constituting economic structure; determines superstructure in the last instance
source: Marx, Zur Kritik der politischen Ökonomie, Vorwort

differential: historischer Materialismus: not economic determinism but the thesis that social being determines consciousness, not vice versa
source: Marx, Zur Kritik der politischen Ökonomie, Vorwort

differential: signifiant: not Saussure's acoustic image but the material element of the symbolic chain; signifier represents the subject for another signifier
signifié: perpetually slides under the signifier; the bar between S/s is resistant to signification, not a stable correspondence
jouissance: not pleasure but an excessive satisfaction beyond the pleasure principle; painful enjoyment that transgresses
désir: always desire of the Other; metonymical movement along the signifying chain, never fully satisfied, constitutively different from need and demand
pulsion (Trieb): not instinct but a constant force circling the object; its aim is not reaching the object but the circuit itself
grand Autre: the symbolic order as locus of speech and law; radically distinct from the imaginary other (petit autre) of mirror relations
stade du miroir: the infant's jubilant identification with its specular image; founds the ego as an alienated imaginary formation
le Réel: not reality but what resists symbolization absolutely; encountered as trauma, impossibility, or the breakdown of meaning
le Symbolique: the register of language, law, and signifying chains; structures the subject through the Name-of-the-Father
l'Imaginaire: the register of images, identifications, and dual relations; site of ego-formation and méconnaissance
sujet: the barred subject ($) divided by the signifier; not the ego or the person but the effect of the signifying chain
objet petit a: the object-cause of desire; not a real object but a remainder produced by the subject's entry into language, untranslatable by design
Dasein: the entity that questions its own being; not a subject or consciousness but being-there as the clearing for Being
Sein: the question of Being (Seinsfrage) is distinct from beings (Seiendes); ontological difference is foundational
In-der-Welt-sein: a unitary structural whole, not a subject placed inside a container; dismantles subject-object split
Sorge: the being of Dasein as ahead-of-itself-already-being-in-a-world; not emotional concern but ontological structure
Sein-zum-Tode: death as Dasein's ownmost, non-relational, certain yet indefinite possibility; individualizes Dasein
Unverborgenheit (aletheia): truth as un-concealment, not correspondence; every revealing simultaneously conceals
Zuhandenheit: equipment encountered in use, transparent and withdrawn; breaks down into present-at-hand when it malfunctions
Vorhandenheit: entities as mere objects of theoretical contemplation; a deficient mode derived from the breakdown of readiness-to-hand
Geworfenheit: Dasein finds itself already thrown into a situation it did not choose; facticity as the ground it cannot get behind
Da: the there of Da-sein; not a spatial location but the disclosedness or clearing in which beings show themselves
différance: neologism combining differing and deferring; neither a word nor a concept, it is the condition of possibility of all signification
déconstruction: not destruction or analysis but the demonstration that texts undermine their own philosophical presuppositions from within
trace: the absent presence within every sign; the mark of what is not there that constitutes what is there
supplément: simultaneously an addition and a replacement; reveals that the origin it supplements was never self-sufficient
logocentrisme: the metaphysical privileging of speech over writing, presence over absence; the target of deconstruction
grammatologie: the science of writing that Derrida both announces and deconstructs; archi-writing precedes the speech/writing opposition
discours: not mere speech but the historically constituted system of statements that produces objects, subjects, and concepts
pouvoir: not possessed but exercised in relations; productive rather than merely repressive; circulates through networks
savoir: distinguished from connaissance; the epistemic conditions that make statements possible within a discursive formation
discipline: a technology of power producing docile bodies through surveillance, normalization, and examination; not just punishment
panoptique: Bentham's architectural figure generalized as the diagram of modern disciplinary power; visibility as a trap
biopolitique: power that administers life at the population level; distinct from sovereign power over death and disciplinary power over bodies
source: Foucault, Il faut défendre la société

differential: souci de soi (epimeleia heautou): ancient ethical practice of self-formation; reframed by Foucault as technologies of the self beyond Cartesian self-knowledge
Wille zur Macht: not will to domination but the self-overcoming drive of all life; an interpretive principle, not a metaphysical substance
ewige Wiederkehr: the thought that everything recurs identically; functions as an existential test — can you will this moment eternally?
Übermensch: not a superior race but the human who overcomes the human; creates values after the death of God; 'superman' is a misleading translation
Genealogie: historical inquiry into the contingent origins of values; exposes the power relations behind moral categories claimed as universal
Nihilismus: the devaluation of the highest values; not a doctrine to adopt but a historical condition to diagnose and overcome
transzendental: not transcendent; concerns the a priori conditions of possibility of experience, not what lies beyond experience
Ding an sich: the object as it is independent of our cognitive faculties; unknowable but thinkable; limit-concept of critical philosophy
Kategorie: pure concepts of the understanding (quantity, quality, relation, modality) that structure all possible experience a priori
Anschauung: immediate sensory presentation of an object; space and time are pure forms of intuition, not empirical abstractions
kategorischer Imperativ: act only according to that maxim you can will as universal law; unconditional moral command independent of consequences
source: Kant, Grundlegung zur Metaphysik der Sitten
